parameters.specification/query:
DEFINE
    VAR CurrentRows =
        FILTER(
            'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal',
            'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[FLOW_OBSERVATION] = "PRE_ROBAL"
        )

    VAR EnrichedRows =
        ADDCOLUMNS(
            CurrentRows,

            "__SampleReagentCount",
                VAR _LotKeyCount = 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[LOT_KEY]
                RETURN
                    COUNTROWS(
                        FILTER(
                            'PQC_SampleReagentByLot',
                            'PQC_SampleReagentByLot'[LOT_KEY] = _LotKeyCount
                        )
                    ),

            "__SampleReagentPNs",
                VAR _LotKeyPN = 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[LOT_KEY]
                VAR _RowsPN =
                    FILTER(
                        'PQC_SampleReagentByLot',
                        'PQC_SampleReagentByLot'[LOT_KEY] = _LotKeyPN
                    )
                VAR _ValuesPN =
                    FILTER(
                        DISTINCT(
                            SELECTCOLUMNS(
                                _RowsPN,
                                "Value", 'PQC_SampleReagentByLot'[SAMPLE_REAGENT_PN]
                            )
                        ),
                        NOT ISBLANK([Value])
                    )
                RETURN
                    CONCATENATEX(_ValuesPN, [Value], " / ", [Value], ASC),

            "__SampleReagentLots",
                VAR _LotKeyLot = 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[LOT_KEY]
                VAR _RowsLot =
                    FILTER(
                        'PQC_SampleReagentByLot',
                        'PQC_SampleReagentByLot'[LOT_KEY] = _LotKeyLot
                    )
                VAR _ValuesLot =
                    FILTER(
                        DISTINCT(
                            SELECTCOLUMNS(
                                _RowsLot,
                                "Value", 'PQC_SampleReagentByLot'[SAMPLE_REAGENT_LOT]
                            )
                        ),
                        NOT ISBLANK([Value])
                    )
                RETURN
                    CONCATENATEX(_ValuesLot, [Value], " / ", [Value], ASC),

            "__SampleReagentLotsExtended",
                VAR _LotKeyExt = 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[LOT_KEY]
                VAR _RowsExt =
                    FILTER(
                        'PQC_SampleReagentByLot',
                        'PQC_SampleReagentByLot'[LOT_KEY] = _LotKeyExt
                    )
                VAR _ValuesExt =
                    FILTER(
                        DISTINCT(
                            SELECTCOLUMNS(
                                _RowsExt,
                                "Value", 'PQC_SampleReagentByLot'[SAMPLE_REAGENT_LOT_EXTENDED]
                            )
                        ),
                        NOT ISBLANK([Value])
                    )
                RETURN
                    CONCATENATEX(_ValuesExt, [Value], " / ", [Value], ASC),

            "__SampleReagentCepheidIDs",
                VAR _LotKeyCepheid = 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[LOT_KEY]
                VAR _RowsCepheid =
                    FILTER(
                        'PQC_SampleReagentByLot',
                        'PQC_SampleReagentByLot'[LOT_KEY] = _LotKeyCepheid
                    )
                VAR _ValuesCepheid =
                    FILTER(
                        DISTINCT(
                            SELECTCOLUMNS(
                                _RowsCepheid,
                                "Value", 'PQC_SampleReagentByLot'[SAMPLE_REAGENT_CEPHEID_IDENTIFIER]
                            )
                        ),
                        NOT ISBLANK([Value])
                    )
                RETURN
                    CONCATENATEX(_ValuesCepheid, [Value], " / ", [Value], ASC),

            "__SampleReagentExpiries",
                VAR _LotKeyExpiry = 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[LOT_KEY]
                VAR _RowsExpiry =
                    FILTER(
                        'PQC_SampleReagentByLot',
                        'PQC_SampleReagentByLot'[LOT_KEY] = _LotKeyExpiry
                    )
                VAR _ValuesExpiry =
                    FILTER(
                        DISTINCT(
                            SELECTCOLUMNS(
                                _RowsExpiry,
                                "Value",
                                    IF(
                                        ISBLANK('PQC_SampleReagentByLot'[SAMPLE_REAGENT_EXPIRY]),
                                        BLANK(),
                                        FORMAT(
                                            'PQC_SampleReagentByLot'[SAMPLE_REAGENT_EXPIRY],
                                            "yyyy-MM-dd"
                                        )
                                    )
                            )
                        ),
                        NOT ISBLANK([Value])
                    )
                RETURN
                    CONCATENATEX(_ValuesExpiry, [Value], " / ", [Value], ASC),

            "__SampleReagentStatus",
                VAR _LotKeyStatus = 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[LOT_KEY]
                VAR _RowsStatus =
                    FILTER(
                        'PQC_SampleReagentByLot',
                        'PQC_SampleReagentByLot'[LOT_KEY] = _LotKeyStatus
                    )
                VAR _UnassignedCount =
                    COUNTROWS(
                        FILTER(
                            _RowsStatus,
                            'PQC_SampleReagentByLot'[SAMPLE_REAGENT_STATUS]
                                = "SAMPLE_REAGENT_REQUIRED_NOT_ASSIGNED"
                        )
                    )
                VAR _ExpiryConflictCount =
                    COUNTROWS(
                        FILTER(
                            _RowsStatus,
                            'PQC_SampleReagentByLot'[SAMPLE_REAGENT_STATUS]
                                = "SAMPLE_REAGENT_EXPIRY_CONFLICT"
                        )
                    )
                VAR _ExpiryNotFoundCount =
                    COUNTROWS(
                        FILTER(
                            _RowsStatus,
                            'PQC_SampleReagentByLot'[SAMPLE_REAGENT_STATUS]
                                = "SAMPLE_REAGENT_EXPIRY_NOT_FOUND"
                        )
                    )
                VAR _UnexpectedStatusCount =
                    COUNTROWS(
                        FILTER(
                            _RowsStatus,
                            NOT (
                                'PQC_SampleReagentByLot'[SAMPLE_REAGENT_STATUS]
                                    IN {
                                        "SAMPLE_REAGENT_REQUIRED_NOT_ASSIGNED",
                                        "SAMPLE_REAGENT_EXPIRY_CONFLICT",
                                        "SAMPLE_REAGENT_EXPIRY_NOT_FOUND",
                                        "SAMPLE_REAGENT_AVAILABLE"
                                    }
                            )
                        )
                    )
                RETURN
                    SWITCH(
                        TRUE(),
                        COUNTROWS(_RowsStatus) = 0, "NO_CONTROLLED_SAMPLE_REAGENT",
                        _UnassignedCount > 0, "SAMPLE_REAGENT_REQUIRED_NOT_ASSIGNED",
                        _ExpiryConflictCount > 0, "SAMPLE_REAGENT_EXPIRY_CONFLICT",
                        _ExpiryNotFoundCount > 0, "SAMPLE_REAGENT_EXPIRY_NOT_FOUND",
                        _UnexpectedStatusCount > 0, "SAMPLE_REAGENT_STATUS_UNKNOWN",
                        "SAMPLE_REAGENT_AVAILABLE"
                    ),

            "__SampleReagentAllocationStatus",
                VAR _LotKeyAllocation = 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[LOT_KEY]
                VAR _RowsAllocation =
                    FILTER(
                        'PQC_SampleReagentByLot',
                        'PQC_SampleReagentByLot'[LOT_KEY] = _LotKeyAllocation
                    )
                VAR _ValuesAllocation =
                    FILTER(
                        DISTINCT(
                            SELECTCOLUMNS(
                                _RowsAllocation,
                                "Value", 'PQC_SampleReagentByLot'[FG_BATCH_ALLOCATION_STATUS]
                            )
                        ),
                        NOT ISBLANK([Value])
                    )
                RETURN
                    CONCATENATEX(_ValuesAllocation, [Value], " / ", [Value], ASC),

            "__SampleReagentDetails",
                VAR _LotKeyDetail = 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[LOT_KEY]
                VAR _RowsDetail =
                    FILTER(
                        'PQC_SampleReagentByLot',
                        'PQC_SampleReagentByLot'[LOT_KEY] = _LotKeyDetail
                    )
                RETURN
                    CONCATENATEX(
                        _RowsDetail,
                        COALESCE('PQC_SampleReagentByLot'[SAMPLE_REAGENT_PN], "")
                            & " | "
                            & COALESCE(
                                'PQC_SampleReagentByLot'[SAMPLE_REAGENT_LOT_EXTENDED],
                                "(unassigned)"
                            )
                            & " | "
                            & IF(
                                ISBLANK('PQC_SampleReagentByLot'[SAMPLE_REAGENT_EXPIRY]),
                                "",
                                FORMAT(
                                    'PQC_SampleReagentByLot'[SAMPLE_REAGENT_EXPIRY],
                                    "yyyy-MM-dd"
                                )
                            )
                            & " | "
                            & COALESCE('PQC_SampleReagentByLot'[SAMPLE_REAGENT_STATUS], ""),
                        UNICHAR(10),
                        'PQC_SampleReagentByLot'[SAMPLE_REAGENT_PN],
                        ASC,
                        'PQC_SampleReagentByLot'[SAMPLE_REAGENT_LOT_EXTENDED],
                        ASC
                    ),

            "__LegacyOBRMatchStatus",
                VAR _LotKeyOBRStatus = 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[LOT_KEY]
                VAR _RowsOBRStatus =
                    FILTER(
                        'AutoMapp_LegacyOBRByLot',
                        'AutoMapp_LegacyOBRByLot'[LOT_KEY] = _LotKeyOBRStatus
                    )
                RETURN
                    SWITCH(
                        TRUE(),
                        COUNTROWS(_RowsOBRStatus) = 0, "NOT_APPLICABLE_OR_NOT_IN_SQL09",
                        COUNTROWS(_RowsOBRStatus) = 1, "MATCHED",
                        "DATA_CONFLICT_DUPLICATE_LOT_KEY"
                    ),

            "__KundSrPN",
                VAR _LotKeyKund = 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[LOT_KEY]
                VAR _RowsKund =
                    FILTER(
                        'AutoMapp_LegacyOBRByLot',
                        'AutoMapp_LegacyOBRByLot'[LOT_KEY] = _LotKeyKund
                    )
                RETURN
                    IF(
                        COUNTROWS(_RowsKund) = 1,
                        CONCATENATEX(
                            _RowsKund,
                            'AutoMapp_LegacyOBRByLot'[LEGACY_KUNDSR_PN_CANDIDATE],
                            ""
                        ),
                        BLANK()
                    ),

            "__OBRRuleStatus",
                VAR _LotKeyRule = 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[LOT_KEY]
                VAR _RowsRule =
                    FILTER(
                        'AutoMapp_LegacyOBRByLot',
                        'AutoMapp_LegacyOBRByLot'[LOT_KEY] = _LotKeyRule
                    )
                RETURN
                    IF(
                        COUNTROWS(_RowsRule) = 1,
                        CONCATENATEX(
                            _RowsRule,
                            'AutoMapp_LegacyOBRByLot'[OBR_RULE_STATUS],
                            ""
                        ),
                        BLANK()
                    ),

            "__OBRRequired",
                VAR _LotKeyRequired = 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[LOT_KEY]
                VAR _RowsRequired =
                    FILTER(
                        'AutoMapp_LegacyOBRByLot',
                        'AutoMapp_LegacyOBRByLot'[LOT_KEY] = _LotKeyRequired
                    )
                RETURN
                    IF(
                        COUNTROWS(_RowsRequired) = 1,
                        MAXX(
                            _RowsRequired,
                            IF('AutoMapp_LegacyOBRByLot'[OBR_REQUIRED], 1, 0)
                        ) = 1,
                        BLANK()
                    ),

            "__OBRFolderSuffix",
                VAR _LotKeySuffix = 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[LOT_KEY]
                VAR _RowsSuffix =
                    FILTER(
                        'AutoMapp_LegacyOBRByLot',
                        'AutoMapp_LegacyOBRByLot'[LOT_KEY] = _LotKeySuffix
                    )
                RETURN
                    IF(
                        COUNTROWS(_RowsSuffix) = 1,
                        CONCATENATEX(
                            _RowsSuffix,
                            'AutoMapp_LegacyOBRByLot'[OBR_FOLDER_SUFFIX],
                            ""
                        ),
                        BLANK()
                    )
        )

    VAR DataRows =
        SELECTCOLUMNS(
            EnrichedRows,
            "RecordType", "DATA",
            "LotKey", 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[LOT_KEY],
            "OrderNumber", 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[ORDER_NUMBER],
            "FgBatch", 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[BATCH],
            "MaterialNumber", 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[MATERIAL_NUMBER],
            "LspNumber", 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[LSP_NUMBER],
            "CurrentRobal", 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[CURRENT_PLANNED_ROBAL],
            "CurrentRobalSource", 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[CURRENT_PLANNED_ROBAL_SOURCE],
            "SAPRobal", 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[SAP_ROBAL_WORKCENTER],
            "BYRobal", 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[BY_PLANNED_ROBAL],
            "PlannedStart", 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[CURRENT_PLANNED_START_DATE],
            "PlannedFinish", 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[CURRENT_PLANNED_FINISH_DATE],
            "PlanSource", 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[PLAN_SOURCE],
            "PlanSnapshotAt", 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[PLAN_SNAPSHOT_AT],
            "MESLotCreatedAt", 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[MES_LOT_CREATED_AT],
            "MESLotResource", 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[MES_LOT_RESOURCE],
            "UpcomingStage", 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[AUTOMAPPSCRIPT_STAGE],
            "AutoMappReadiness", 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[AUTOMAPPSCRIPT_READINESS],
            "FlowState", 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[FLOW_OBSERVATION],
            "FGExpDate", 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[FG_EXP_DATE],
            "ProductionVersion", 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[PRODUCTION_VERSION],
            "SAPTotalOrderQty", 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[SAP_TOTAL_ORDER_QTY],
            "CartridgePackSize", 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[CARTRIDGE_PACK_SIZE],
            "CartridgeQuantity", 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[CARTRIDGE_ORDER_QTY],
            "CartridgeQtyStatus", 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[CARTRIDGE_QTY_STATUS],
            "SampleReagentCount", [__SampleReagentCount],
            "SampleReagentPNs", [__SampleReagentPNs],
            "SampleReagentLots", [__SampleReagentLots],
            "SampleReagentLotsExtended", [__SampleReagentLotsExtended],
            "SampleReagentCepheidIDs", [__SampleReagentCepheidIDs],
            "SampleReagentExpiries", [__SampleReagentExpiries],
            "SampleReagentStatus", [__SampleReagentStatus],
            "SampleReagentAllocationStatus", [__SampleReagentAllocationStatus],
            "SampleReagentDetails", [__SampleReagentDetails],
            "LegacyOBRMatchStatus", [__LegacyOBRMatchStatus],
            "KundSrPN", [__KundSrPN],
            "OBRRuleStatus", [__OBRRuleStatus],
            "OBRRequired", [__OBRRequired],
            "OBRFolderSuffix", [__OBRFolderSuffix],
            "SourceSystem", "SNOWFLAKE",
            "SourceRefreshedAtUTC", 'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[PBI_REFRESHED_AT_UTC],
            "SourceRowCount", BLANK(),
            "SourceDistinctLotKeyCount", BLANK(),
            "SourceDuplicateLotKeyCount", BLANK(),
            "SourceSampleReagentRowCount", BLANK(),
            "SourceLegacyOBRRowCount", BLANK()
        )

    VAR ControlRow =
        ROW(
            "RecordType", "CONTROL",
            "LotKey", BLANK(),
            "OrderNumber", BLANK(),
            "FgBatch", BLANK(),
            "MaterialNumber", BLANK(),
            "LspNumber", BLANK(),
            "CurrentRobal", BLANK(),
            "CurrentRobalSource", BLANK(),
            "SAPRobal", BLANK(),
            "BYRobal", BLANK(),
            "PlannedStart", BLANK(),
            "PlannedFinish", BLANK(),
            "PlanSource", BLANK(),
            "PlanSnapshotAt", BLANK(),
            "MESLotCreatedAt", BLANK(),
            "MESLotResource", BLANK(),
            "UpcomingStage", BLANK(),
            "AutoMappReadiness", BLANK(),
            "FlowState", BLANK(),
            "FGExpDate", BLANK(),
            "ProductionVersion", BLANK(),
            "SAPTotalOrderQty", BLANK(),
            "CartridgePackSize", BLANK(),
            "CartridgeQuantity", BLANK(),
            "CartridgeQtyStatus", BLANK(),
            "SampleReagentCount", BLANK(),
            "SampleReagentPNs", BLANK(),
            "SampleReagentLots", BLANK(),
            "SampleReagentLotsExtended", BLANK(),
            "SampleReagentCepheidIDs", BLANK(),
            "SampleReagentExpiries", BLANK(),
            "SampleReagentStatus", BLANK(),
            "SampleReagentAllocationStatus", BLANK(),
            "SampleReagentDetails", BLANK(),
            "LegacyOBRMatchStatus", BLANK(),
            "KundSrPN", BLANK(),
            "OBRRuleStatus", BLANK(),
            "OBRRequired", BLANK(),
            "OBRFolderSuffix", BLANK(),
            "SourceSystem", "SNOWFLAKE",
            "SourceRefreshedAtUTC",
                MAXX(
                    CurrentRows,
                    'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[PBI_REFRESHED_AT_UTC]
                ),
            "SourceRowCount", COUNTROWS(CurrentRows),
            "SourceDistinctLotKeyCount",
                COUNTROWS(
                    SUMMARIZE(
                        CurrentRows,
                        'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[LOT_KEY]
                    )
                ),
            "SourceDuplicateLotKeyCount",
                COUNTROWS(CurrentRows)
                    - COUNTROWS(
                        SUMMARIZE(
                            CurrentRows,
                            'PQC_UpcomingPreRobal'[LOT_KEY]
                        )
                    ),
            "SourceSampleReagentRowCount",
                COUNTROWS('PQC_SampleReagentByLot'),
            "SourceLegacyOBRRowCount",
                COUNTROWS('AutoMapp_LegacyOBRByLot')
        )

EVALUATE
    UNION(ControlRow, DataRows)

runError.message: BMRAM-Snow query failed or timed out. No SharePoint writes started. Verify model refresh and the three Import tables.
@concat('Expected exactly 1 CONTROL row; received ', string(length(body('CONTROL_Rows'))), '. No SharePoint writes started.')
@concat('SourceRowCount must be greater than 0; received ', string(outputs('Source_Diagnostics')?['SourceRowCount']), '. No SharePoint writes started.')

@concat('SourceRowCount=', string(outputs('Source_Diagnostics')?['SourceRowCount']), '; SourceDistinctLotKeyCount=', string(outputs('Source_Diagnostics')?['SourceDistinctLotKeyCount']), '. Counts must match. No SharePoint writes started.')
@concat('SourceDuplicateLotKeyCount must be 0; received ', string(outputs('Source_Diagnostics')?['SourceDuplicateLotKeyCount']), '. No SharePoint writes started.')

@concat('DATA row count=', string(length(body('DATA_Rows'))), '; SourceRowCount=', string(outputs('Source_Diagnostics')?['SourceRowCount']), '. Truncated or incomplete source. No SharePoint writes started.')
Source validation failed or timed out, including malformed row/count values. Inspect Validate_Source and Source_Diagnostics. No SharePoint writes started.

value.message: @concat('Multiple SharePoint items for LotKey=', items('For_Each_DATA_Row')?['[LotKey]'], '. No write was made for this LotKey; later rows are skipped. Earlier successful writes remain. Resolve duplicate Title/LotKey items and rerun.')

@concat('SharePoint lookup/create/update failed for LotKey=', items('For_Each_DATA_Row')?['[LotKey]'], '. Later rows are skipped; earlier writes remain. Inspect Try_Upsert and rerun after correcting the failure.')

For_Each_DATA_Row.description: Sequential upserts. A duplicate or connector failure latches varSyncFailure; later iterations skip all SharePoint actions. Terminate runs outside the loop.

runError.message: The DATA loop failed or timed out. Inspect For_Each_DATA_Row. The run is incomplete; earlier writes may remain. No stale cleanup exists.
